name: dumbbell sumo squat off benches
description: A wide squat with feet on benches that extends the range of motion for the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Place a bench under each foot with a wide stance.
Hold a dumbbell in front of you with both hands.
Sit your hips down between the benches.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hips.
Push through your heels to stand.
